For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment

PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED ATC (ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS) Hiring of Non-AC Commercial Vehicle for Medical Department, Divisional Railway Hospital, Solapur, Central Railway 1. Type of Vehicle: The bidder shall provide a Non-AC commercial vehicle (Yellow Number Plate) in good condition, suitable for official use by the Me dical Department, Divisional Railway Hospital, Solapur (DRH/SUR). 2. Ownership of Vehicle: The bidder shall submit documentary proof of ownersh ip of the offered vehicle in the form of Registration Certificate (RC Book) or T ax Invoice. The RC/Tax Invoice shall be in the name of the bidder/firm. In case the vehicle is registered in another person's or firm's name, a duly notarized Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), specifically authorizing deployment of the vehicle for this tender and mentioning the GeM Bid Number, shall be sub mitted along with the bid. 3. Model and Age of Vehicle: The vehicle offered shall be of Model Year 2023, 2 024, 2025 or 2026 and shall not be more than three years old as on the date of bid submission. 4. Kilometre Reading: The vehicle shall not have run more than 25,000 kilometr es. The bidder shall mandatorily submit documentary proof of the odometer r eading along with the bid. 5. Documentary Evidence: Quotation copies, booking receipts, temporary booki ng documents or mere undertakings shall not be accepted as documentary p roof of ownership or purchase of the vehicle during evaluation. 6. Location of Service Provider: The Service Provider shall have a functional offi ce within the State of Maharashtra. Documentary evidence regarding the offi ce address shall be submitted along with the bid. 7. Place of Deployment: The vehicle shall primarily be deployed at Divisional Ra ilway Hospital, Solapur (DRH/SUR), Medical Department, Central Railway. The vehicle may also be utilized for official duties within or outside Solapur Divisio n, including inter-state journeys, as and when required by the Railway Admini stration.

8. Duty Hours: The services of the vehicle shall be required for 320 hours per m onth. The vehicle shall also be made available on a 24×7 basis during emerg encies or other exigencies, as directed by the Chief Medical Superintendent, Solapur or his/her authorized representative, in accordance with the applicabl e GeM contract provisions. 9. Deployment of Vehicle: The Service Provider shall ensure that the assigned v ehicle along with the driver reports for duty within 24 hours of confirmation of the work order or within the period mutually agreed upon with the Railway A dministration. 10. Parking of Vehicle: The vehicle deployed shall remain parked within the premi ses of Divisional Railway Hospital, Solapur, after duty hours, whenever desire d by the Railway Administration. The vehicle shall not be taken out of the hos pital premises without prior permission of the authorized Railway official. 11. Fuel and Maintenance: The vehicle shall report for duty with a full or sufficient tank of fuel. All expenses towards fuel, lubricants, repairs, servicing, mainten ance, insurance, permits, taxes and other statutory requirements shall be bor ne entirely by the Service Provider. 12. Fastag and Toll Charges: The Service Provider shall provide the vehicle with a functional FASTag having sufficient balance. All toll charges, parking fees, entry taxes and similar charges payable locally or during outstation journeys shall be borne by the Service Provider without any additional liability to the R ailway Administration. 13. Statutory Documents: The vehicle shall possess all valid statutory documents, including: i. Registration Certificate (RC). ii. Commercial Registration/Permit. iii. Fitness Certificate, wherever applicable. iv. Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate. v. Comprehensive Insurance Policy. vi. Road Permit/National Permit, wherever applicable. vii. Any other licence, permission or clearance required under the Motor Vehicl es Act and applicable rules. 14. Condition of Vehicle: The vehicle shall be in excellent mechanical and roadwo rthy condition at all times. It shall be thoroughly cleaned internally and extern ally and shall remain free from dust, rubbish, oil, bad odour and personal belo ngings of the driver. 15. Emergency Equipment: The vehicle shall be equipped with a functional emerg ency medical first-aid kit, fire extinguisher and hand sanitizer at all times.

16. Driver's Qualification: The driver deployed shall possess a valid driving licenc e appropriate for the category of vehicle and shall have a minimum of two ye ars of driving experience. 17. Driver's Conduct and Uniform: The driver shall be well-mannered, suitably trai ned, familiar with local areas and routes, and shall report for duty punctually i n a clean white uniform with a name badge displaying his name, mobile num ber and blood group. The cost of the uniform shall be borne by the Service Pr ovider. 18. Communication Facility: The driver shall possess a functional mobile phone wi th an active internet connection to facilitate communication and navigation th rough Google Maps or any equivalent navigation application. The driver shall remain reachable throughout the duty hours. 19. Police Verification: The Service Provider shall submit the Police Verification Ce rtificate of the deployed driver within one month from the commencement of the contract. In case of failure to submit the same within the stipulated perio d, a penalty of ₹100 per day shall be imposed until submission, subject to app licable contract provisions. 20. Conduct of Driver: The driver shall maintain polite and courteous behaviour towards Railway officers, Medical Department officials, patients and hospital staff. Consumption of alcohol or intoxicants during or prior to duty, refusal to perform assigned duties, use of abusive language, theft or any other miscond uct shall attract appropriate penalties, including replacement of the driver or termination of the contract as per applicable conditions. 21. Change of Driver: The Railway Administration shall have the right to seek repl acement of the driver by giving one month's notice to the Service Provider. T he Service Provider shall not change the deployed driver without prior written approval of the competent Railway authority, except in emergencies with im mediate intimation. Non-compliance may attract penalties or termination of t he contract. 22. Delay in Reporting: The vehicle along with the driver shall report at the desig nated location at the stipulated time. Delay in reporting beyond 15 minutes s hall attract penalties as per the GeM Service Level Agreement (SLA) and appli cable contract conditions. 23. Replacement of Vehicle: In case the deployed vehicle becomes unavailable d ue to breakdown, accident, seizure, detention, requisition by Police/Motor Ve hicle Authorities or any other reason, the Service Provider shall immediately arrange an equivalent Non-AC commercial replacement vehicle without interr uption of services and at no additional cost to the Railway Administration. 24. Unauthorized Passengers: The vehicle deployed for official duty shall not carr y any person other than personnel authorized by the Railway Administration ( Medical Department).

25. Calculation of Duty Hours: The chargeable service time shall commence from the point of pick-up and shall end at the point of final drop-off. Time and kilo metres consumed for travelling to and from the garage for servicing, repairs, maintenance or refuelling shall not be included in duty hours or chargeable kilometres. 26. Utilization of Vehicle: The Railway Administration shall be entitled to utilize th e hired vehicle for official purposes within the scope of the contract. Howeve r, at no time during or after completion of the contract shall the ownership of the hired vehicle be transferred to the Railway Administration. 27. Responsibility for Accidents: The Railway Administration (Medical Department ) shall not be liable for any loss, damage, accident, injury or claim arising out of the operation or deployment of the Service Provider's vehicle, including da mage to public property or injury to any third person. 28. Violation of Traffic Rules: The Railway Administration shall in no way be respo nsible for any violation of traffic rules, Motor Vehicle laws or infringement of a ny other statutory provisions by the driver or the Service Provider. The entire responsibility shall rest with the Service Provider. 29. Subletting of Contract: The Service Provider shall not sublet or assign any part of the contract. However, the Service Provider may act as an aggregator of v ehicles/individual drivers, provided that the Service Provider shall remain full y responsible and liable for satisfactory execution of the contract. 30. Labour Law Compliance: The driver and other personnel engaged by the Servi ce Provider shall remain employees of the Service Provider only and shall not be deemed employees of the Railway Administration. Compliance with all app licable labour laws, including EPF, ESIC, Minimum Wages, Motor Transport Wo rkers and other statutory provisions, shall be the sole responsibility of the Ser vice Provider. 31. Rates and Taxes: The rates quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of all appli cable taxes, duties and GST. No additional payment shall be admissible towar ds fuel, maintenance, driver charges, insurance, permits, taxes or other expe nses, except as specifically provided in the GeM contract. 32. Change in Schedule: The Railway Administration shall notify the Service Provi der of any change in the deployment schedule, ordinarily 24 hours in advanc e, wherever practicable. However, in case of medical emergencies and other exigencies, the vehicle shall be made available as directed by the competent Railway authority. 33. Penalties: Penalties shall be imposed as per the applicable GeM Service Level Agreement (SLA) and contract conditions. In case of any irregularity or incide nt not specifically covered under the SLA, the Chief Medical Superintendent, Solapur, shall be competent to take appropriate action as per the terms of th e contract and applicable rules.

34. General Conditions: The contract shall be governed by the General Conditions of Contract (GCC) for Services, 2018, along with all latest amendments and c orrection slips issued from time to time, and the applicable GeM General Ter ms and Conditions and Service Level Agreement. 35. Right of Acceptance: The Tender Accepting Authority reserves the right to acc ept, reject or cancel the tender, wholly or partly, in accordance with applicabl e rules and without assigning any reason. 36. All the above conditions shall be read in conjunction with the GeM bid docum ent, GeM General Terms and Conditions, applicable GCC and Service Level Ag reement. In case of any discrepancy, the applicable contractual provisions sh all prevail. 37. Compliance with New Labour Codes: The Service Provider/Contractor shall stri ctly comply with all applicable provisions of the Labour Codes enacted by the Government of India, including the Code on Wages, 2019, Industrial Relations Code, 2020, Code on Social Security, 2020 and Occupational Safety, Health a nd Working Conditions Code, 2020, along with applicable Rules, notifications and statutory amendments brought into force from time to time. 38. Appointment Letter: The Contractor shall issue a formal appointment letter to the driver deployed for the hired vehicle, clearly indicating the terms and con ditions of employment, designation, monthly wages, working hours and other applicable service conditions. A copy of the appointment letter shall be submi tted to the Railway Administration before commencement of duty. 39. Payment of Wages: The Contractor shall ensure timely payment of wages to t he deployed driver strictly in accordance with the applicable minimum wages notified by the appropriate Government, including applicable Variable Dearn ess Allowance (VDA), overtime wages, weekly rest and other statutory benefit s, wherever applicable. Payment shall be made through bank transfer or othe r legally permissible mode, and documentary proof shall be maintained. 40. Submission of Monthly Labour Documents: Along with each monthly running bill, the Contractor shall mandatorily submit the following documents relating to the driver deployed during the corresponding billing month: i. Driver-wise wage payment statement indicating the name of the drive r, designation, number of working days, basic wages, applicable VDA, ov ertime (if any), statutory deductions and net wages paid. ii. Copy of the appointment letter issued to the deployed driver. iii. Individual monthly wage slip/pay slip duly issued to and acknowledged by the driver, containing complete details of wages and deductions. iv. Bank statement/payment transaction proof or other acceptable docum entary evidence establishing actual payment of wages to the driver. v. Attendance/muster roll duly signed by the deployed driver on each wor king day and countersigned/verified by the authorized Railway represen tative. vi. Documentary proof of deposit of applicable statutory contributions suc h as EPF and ESIC, wherever applicable.

41. Maintenance of Attendance Register: The Contractor shall ensure that the de ployed driver personally signs the attendance/muster roll on every day of dut y. The attendance shall also be verified and countersigned by the designated Railway representative. The Contractor shall maintain proper attendance and wage records and produce the same whenever demanded by the Railway Ad ministration or any statutory authority. 42. Condition for Processing of Monthly Bills: Submission of the above-mentioned labour compliance documents shall be mandatory along with every monthly bill. In the absence of the prescribed documents, or in case of non-payment/s hort payment of wages to the deployed driver, the Railway Administration sh all be entitled to withhold processing of the concerned monthly bill until satis factory compliance is established by the Contractor. No claim for interest or c ompensation on account of such withholding due to non-compliance shall be entertained. 43. Responsibility of Contractor: The Contractor shall be solely responsible for co mpliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory obligations in respect o f the driver and other personnel engaged by him. The Railway Administration shall not be responsible for any dispute, claim, liability, compensation or stat utory dues arising out of the employment of such personnel. 44. Verification and Inspection: The Railway Administration shall have the right to verify the attendance records, wage payment records, appointment letters, w age slips, bank payment proofs and statutory compliance documents submitt ed by the Contractor. The Contractor shall produce original records whenever required for verification. 45. Non-Compliance: Any failure, discrepancy, false declaration, non-payment or short payment of wages, or submission of fabricated/incorrect labour records shall be treated as a breach of contractual conditions and shall attract approp riate action, including withholding of bills, recovery of applicable dues, penalti es or termination of the contract, in accordance with the GeM contract, applic able laws and rules. 46. Work Experience: The bidder should have satisfactorily completed* in the l ast three previous financial years and the current financial year up to the dat e of opening of the tender, one similar single service contract** for a mi nimum of 35% of advertised value of the bid.

* Completed service contract includes on-going service contract subject t o payment of bills amounting to at least 35% of the advertised value of the bi d. ** Past Experience of Similar Services: Copies of contracts / work orders and documentary evidence of successful execution / completion in support of Past Experience of Similar Services along with names, address and contact d etails of clients shall be uploaded with the bid for verification by the Buyer. ***Similar service contract means any contract that is so specified by co mponent Authority Similar work in this context includes following: “The contractor Shall have experience in carrying out similar servic e contract such as involving hiring of Vehicle in Railway hospital , C entral/State Government hospitals, or Multi specialty hospitals.” a) The bidder shall submit details of work executed by them along with bid fo r the contracts to be considered for qualification of work experience criteria clearly indicating the nature/scope of contract, actual completion cost and ac tual date of completion for such contract. b)Certificates from private individuals/Organization shall not be considered. C ertificates from Central Govt./PSUs only shall be considered. c)Composite works will not be considered, only the works falling under definition of Similar nature only will be considered. 47. Financial Standing: The Bidders will be qualified only if they have minimu m financial capabilities as below i) T1- Financial Turnover: The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover not less than 1.5 times the advertised Bid value during the la st three previous financial years and in the current financial year up to the d ate of opening of the tender. The audited balance sheet reflecting financial tu rnover certified by chartered accountant with her stamp, signature and mem bership number shall be considered. ii) T2-Liquidity: The bidder should have access to or has available liquid asset s, lines of credit and other financial means to meet cash flow that is val ued at 5% of the estimated bid value net of applicant’s commitments for other contracts. The audited balance sheet or provisional balance sheet duly certified by chartered accountant with her stamp, signature and membership number and/or banking reference issued by bank shall be submitted by the bi dder along with bid. Banking reference should contain in clear terms the amount that bank will b e in a position to lend for this work to the applicant/member of the Joint Vent ure/Consortium. In case the Net Current Assets (as seen from the Balance Sh eets) are negative, only the Banking references will be considered. Otherwis e, the aggregate of the Net Current Assets and submitted Banking references will be considered for working out the Liquidity. The banking reference should be from a Scheduled Bank in India and it should not be more than 3 months old as on date of submission of bids. .
